WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT 
    f.feerate,
    f.rebrate,
    o.mktnote
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
net_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    feerate - rebrate AS net_fee_rate,
    mktnote
  FROM matched_fees
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS bench_rate
  FROM net_rates
),
pair_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    mktnote,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM net_rates
  GROUP BY mktnote
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT 
    p.avg_net_fee_rate,
    p.avg_net_fee_rate - b.bench_rate AS excess
  FROM pair_avgs p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.bench_rate
    AND b.bench_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_of_avg_rates,
  AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM above_benchmark;
